static_traits.name: Chen Yisen
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友关系因Self-doubt而紧张；有少数亲密朋友但很少分享内心
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；not yet有类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Negative attitude but clear expression; able to cooperate in discussion and goal setting; low tone, logic still acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: 对自己作为Makeup artist的职业潜力产生Self-doubt与not够好的感受，这些情绪在多次求职失败后出现，并影响自尊与求职动力。
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings are hindering my pursuit of my passion for makeup art and affecting my self-esteem, so I decided to come to counseling.
growth_experiences: 受Mother（职业Makeup artist）影响，早期接触并投入化妆艺术训练，觉得过程有趣且自认为表现Good。
进入化妆行业求职阶段后，多次投递岗位却not yet获录用，常收到通用拒信或被反馈“经验not足/not合适”，Decreased self-confidence；Sees successful makeup artists or beauty bloggers on social media时加重比较与自卑，进而影响与朋友的关系与日常动力。

special_situations.event: Sees successful makeup artists or beauty bloggers on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我达not到他们的水平，就说明I am not good enough、not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing媒体或加倍完善作品集，但仍频繁进行自我比较
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，我做错了什么

special_situations.event: 收到求职的通用拒信或被告知“经验not足/not合适”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Being rejected，就证明我not适合这个行业、将来也not会被录用
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Mainly applies broadly online; reduces face-to-face interaction and in-depth networking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能永远找not到能维持生活的职位

special_situations.event: Considers contacting a successful makeup artist for advice or mentor support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我主动联系，他们会看not起我，not会愿意帮助我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not主动联系、独自摸索，避免潜在的拒绝

special_situations.event: 参加行业社交/网络活动时感到“格格not入”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能立刻融入，就说明我not属于这个圈子
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少Attending social activities，回避线下网络拓展机会

core_conflict.wish: Longs, as a makeup artist, to be seen and recognized, to obtain a stable and decent job and professional belonging
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被negate，担心被比较后显得not够好、失去价值感
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being rejected again by avoiding seeking help and reducing exposure
以Self-doubt与保守尝试来维持脆弱自尊的安全感

object_relations.self_representation: not够经验、容易被拒的求职者/旁观者
object_relations.object_representation: Critical and easily rejecting industry and employers
The superior and unapproachable successful person/role model

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests contacting a successful makeup artist for advice or mentor support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为对方会看not起自己、not会给予帮助（移情：将内在Self-denial投向他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、Empathy验证；以开放式QuestioningClarification证据与可能性，避免对抗；邀请具体尝试的小步行动。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当讨论Attending social activities或尝试新的求职策略时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者以“这可能又是死胡同”为由降低行动，倾向用表面合理的理由Interpretationnot行动
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持支持性语气；use具体化与行为细分的语言，帮助识do not可执行的最小步并评估真实障碍。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在遭遇重复拒信或反馈“经验not足”后谈及自我感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对外的挫败与not满转为自责与自我攻击（如“I am not good enough”）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses an accepting and compassionate tone; encourages emotion labeling and externalizing frustration, distinguishes facts from self-worth; guides functional self-support language.

manifestations: Avoids proactively contacting successful people for advice or mentor support
Rarely sharing inner feelings with friends, turning frustration into self-blame and self-attack

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 假定他人not会愿意帮助自己，认为对方看not起自己

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
